policy.notes: External dictionaries and grade corpora are candidate/reference data. Learning-profile placement and child-facing pedagogy remain Kidsplay-authored/reviewed concerns. Open derivative datasets with share-alike terms stay license-isolated from application code and independent Kidsplay editorial content.

sources.name: Open English WordNet
sources.provenanceRequirement: Preserve upstream sense/synset identifiers and attribution for imported or adapted licensed material.

sources.name: WortUniversum English Vocabulary Database
sources.provenanceRequirement: Keep the reduced candidate snapshot and derivatives under CC BY-SA 4.0 with source attribution/revision. Do not copy source definitions/examples into Kidsplay-authored child content automatically.

sources.name: NoRaRe CLDF release
sources.provenanceRequirement: Use only the released norare-cldf dataset under its published CC BY 4.0 terms; preserve dataset/variable provenance.

sources.name: Princeton WordNet 3.0
sources.provenanceRequirement: Preserve the WordNet copyright, license and disclaimer requirements when redistributing covered database material.

sources.name: Wiktionary via Kaikki/wiktextract
sources.provenanceRequirement: Keep imported/adapted Wiktionary text separately traceable and satisfy attribution/share-alike requirements; do not silently merge it into Kidsplay-authored editorial definitions.

sources.name: NoRaRe data curation repository
sources.provenanceRequirement: Non-commercial repository license is incompatible with Kidsplay's paid learning path; use the CC BY 4.0 norare-cldf release instead when applicable.

sources.name: Vocabulary by Grade Level (VXGL)
sources.provenanceRequirement: Do not import or ship VXGL-derived product data while its published license is non-commercial.
